title: Extracting PAC Decision Trees from Black Box Binary Classifiers: The Gender Bias Case Study on BERT-based Language Models
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on PAC guarantees for decision tree extraction and a case study on gender bias.
